Tomato_Early Blight.symptoms: Dark brown to black concentric target-ring spots on older leaves, yellow halo.

Mild.organic_treatment: Spray Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) or Trichoderma viride (5g/L water). Remove lower infected leaves and destroy them.
Mild.chemical_treatment: Preventive spray of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0g/L water.
Mild.dosage_hindi: नीम का तेल (5 मिली/लीटर पानी) या मैंकोज़ेब 75% WP (2 ग्राम/लीटर पानी)।
Mild.irrigation_advice: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; water at base in the morning.

Moderate.organic_treatment: Copper hydroxide 77% WP @ 2g/L or Bordeaux mixture (1%) combined with cow urine spray (10%).
Moderate.chemical_treatment: Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L OR Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L water.
Moderate.dosage_hindi: डाइफेनोकोनाज़ोल 25% EC (1 मिली प्रति लीटर) या क्लोरोथैलोनिल 75% WP (2 ग्राम प्रति लीटर)।
Moderate.irrigation_advice: Ensure proper field drainage and mulch around base to prevent soil splash.

Severe.organic_treatment: Emergency copper-based bactericide/fungicide spray after roguing out severely affected plants.
Severe.chemical_treatment: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1ml/L OR Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.5ml/L water. Repeat after 10 days.
Severe.dosage_hindi: अज़ॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन + डाइफेनोकोनाज़ोल (1 मिली/लीटर) या टेबुकोनाज़ोल (1.5 मिली/लीटर)। गंभीर पत्तों को काटकर जलाएं।
Severe.irrigation_advice: Strictly withhold excess irrigation to lower field humidity.

Tomato_Late Blight.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular greasy spots turning dark brown with white fungal mold underneath in humid conditions.

Mild.organic_treatment: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L water mixed with biological agent Pseudomonas fluorescens (10g/L).
Mild.dosage_hindi: मेटालेक्सिल + मैंकोज़ेब (रिडोमिल) 2.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में तुरंत छिड़कें।
Mild.irrigation_advice: Stop evening irrigations immediately; lower relative humidity in canopy.

Moderate.organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%) spray covering both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Moderate.chemical_treatment: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2g/L OR Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1g/L water.
Moderate.dosage_hindi: साइमोक्सानिल + मैंकोज़ेब (2 ग्राम/लीटर) या डाइमर्थोमोर्फ 50% WP (1 ग्राम/लीटर)।
Moderate.irrigation_advice: Improve row ventilation; stake tomato plants to elevate leaves from wet soil.

Severe.organic_treatment: Quarantine the infected patch, burn severely destroyed plants to prevent spore dispersal.
Severe.chemical_treatment: Famoxadone 16.6% + Cymoxanil 22.1% SC @ 1ml/L OR Mandipropamid 23.4% SC @ 0.8ml/L water.
Severe.dosage_hindi: मैंडिप्रोपामाइड (0.8 मिली/लीटर) या फैमोक्साडोन + साइमोक्सानिल (1 मिली/लीटर)। 7 दिनों बाद दूसरा छिड़काव करें।
Severe.irrigation_advice: Cease irrigation for 48 hours unless plants show wilt.

Potato_Early Blight.symptoms: Concentric rings (target board) on lower leaves, spreading upward.

Mild.organic_treatment: Spray Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L water with sticker. Mulch beds.
Mild.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L water or Propineb 70% WP @ 2g/L.
Mild.dosage_hindi: मैंकोज़ेब 75% WP (2.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी) का निवारक छिड़काव करें।
Mild.irrigation_advice: Avoid waterlogging; maintain moderate soil moisture.

Moderate.organic_treatment: Spray Neem oil 10,000 ppm @ 3ml/L water + Copper Oxychloride 2g/L.
Moderate.chemical_treatment: Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L OR Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L water.
Moderate.dosage_hindi: डाइफेनोकोनाज़ोल (1 मिली प्रति लीटर) या टेबुकोनाज़ोल (1 मिली/लीटर)।
Moderate.irrigation_advice: Irrigate alternate furrows to reduce micro-climate dampness.

Severe.organic_treatment: Rogue out infected haulms; harvest early if tubers are mature.
Severe.chemical_treatment: Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1g/L OR Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L water.
Severe.dosage_hindi: पाइराक्लोस्ट्रोबिन 20% WG (1 ग्राम/लीटर) या अज़ॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन 23% SC (1 मिली/लीटर)।

Potato_Late Blight.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins, white cottony mold under high humidity, rapid plant collapse.

Mild.organic_treatment: Prophylactic spray of Copper Hydroxide @ 2g/L water.
Mild.dosage_hindi: मैंकोज़ेब 75% WP (2.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी) मौसम में नमी आते ही छिड़कें।
Mild.irrigation_advice: Keep furrows dry; avoid evening sprinkling.

Moderate.organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture 1% spray covering foliage thoroughly.
Moderate.chemical_treatment: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5g/L OR Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2g/L.
Moderate.dosage_hindi: रिडोमिल (मेटालेक्सिल + मैंकोज़ेब) 2.5 ग्राम/लीटर या साइमोक्सानिल + मैंकोज़ेब 2 ग्राम/लीटर।
Moderate.irrigation_advice: Strict furrow irrigation; avoid splashing soil on leaves.

Severe.organic_treatment: Dehaulm (cut foliage above ground) immediately to prevent spore migration into tubers.
Severe.chemical_treatment: Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1g/L + Mancozeb 2g/L OR Fenamidone 10% + Mancozeb 50% WG @ 2.5g/L.
Severe.dosage_hindi: डाइमर्थोमोर्फ (1 ग्राम/लीटर) + मैंकोज़ेब (2 ग्राम/लीटर)। कंदों को बचाने के लिए तुरंत बेल काट दें।
Severe.irrigation_advice: Do not irrigate; keep tubers dry in soil until harvest.

Rice (Paddy)_Leaf Blast.symptoms: Spindle-shaped / diamond-shaped lesions with gray center and brown margin on leaves and leaf collars.

Mild.organic_treatment: Seed treatment / foliar spray with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/L water.
Mild.dosage_hindi: ट्राइसाइक्लाज़ोल 75% WP (0.6 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी) का छिड़काव करें।
Mild.irrigation_advice: Maintain shallow 2-3 cm standing water; avoid drying the field.

Moderate.organic_treatment: Spray Neem oil 3ml/L + Cow dung slurry supernatant (5%).
Moderate.chemical_treatment: Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5ml/L OR Kasugamycin 3% SL @ 2.5ml/L water.
Moderate.dosage_hindi: आइसोप्रोथियोलेन 40% EC (1.5 मिली/लीटर) या कासुगामाइसिन (2.5 मिली/लीटर)।
Moderate.irrigation_advice: Avoid high nitrogen (urea) top-dressing; split nitrogen applications.

Severe.organic_treatment: Apply bio-control formulation with silicon fertilizer foliar spray.
Severe.chemical_treatment: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1ml/L OR Tebuconazole 50% + Trifloxystrobin 25% WG (Nativo) @ 0.4g/L.
Severe.dosage_hindi: नेटिवो (टेबुकोनाज़ोल + ट्राइफ्लॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन) 0.4 ग्राम/लीटर पानी में छिड़कें। यूरिया तुरंत बंद करें।
Severe.irrigation_advice: Drain field for 24 hours, then re-flood to dilute soil nitrogen.

Corn (Maize)_Common Rust.symptoms: Golden-brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules scattered on upper and lower leaf surfaces.

Mild.organic_treatment: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L water + fermented buttermilk spray (5%).
Mild.dosage_hindi: मैंकोज़ेब 75% WP (2.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी) या छाछ का छिड़काव।
Mild.irrigation_advice: Irrigate in the morning so sun dries leaf surfaces rapidly.

Moderate.dosage_hindi: प्रोपिकोनाज़ोल 25% EC (टिल्ट) 1 मिली प्रति लीटर पानी में छिड़कें।

Severe.organic_treatment: Remove severely dried lower leaves; apply silicon amendment.
Severe.chemical_treatment: Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L OR Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1g/L water.
Severe.dosage_hindi: अज़ॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन 23% SC (1 मिली/लीटर)। भुट्टा पकने से पहले दोबारा छिड़काव करें।

Cotton_Bollworm Infestation.symptoms: Bored holes in bolls, flower shedding (rosette flowers), chewed leaves with frass.

Mild.organic_treatment: Install 5 pheromone traps per acre. Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2g/L or NSKE 5%.
Mild.dosage_hindi: फेरोमोन ट्रैप (5 प्रति एकड़) लगाएं और नीम का काढ़ा या बीटी (2 ग्राम/लीटर) छिड़कें।
Mild.irrigation_advice: Maintain normal irrigation; avoid water stress during square formation.

Moderate.organic_treatment: Release Trichogramma egg parasitoids @ 60,000/acre. Spray HaNPV @ 250 LE/acre.
Moderate.chemical_treatment: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.5g/L OR Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3ml/L water.
Moderate.dosage_hindi: एमामेक्टिन बेंजोएट 5% SG (0.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर) या स्पिनोसैड 45% SC (0.3 मिली/लीटर)।

Severe.organic_treatment: Collect and destroy infested bolls manually; mass trapping with 15 pheromone traps/acre.
Severe.chemical_treatment: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (Coragen) @ 0.3ml/L OR Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 0.25ml/L water.
Severe.dosage_hindi: कोराजन (क्लोरेंट्रानिलिप्रोल 18.5% SC) 0.3 मिली प्रति लीटर पानी में शाम के समय छिड़कें।
Severe.irrigation_advice: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer which attracts moths.

Wheat_Yellow Rust (Stripe Rust).symptoms: Yellowish-orange pustules arranged in linear stripes between leaf veins, rubs off as yellow powder on fingers.

Mild.organic_treatment: Spray bio-fungicide Trichoderma viride @ 5g/L water + fermented neem extract.
Mild.chemical_treatment: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1ml/L water upon first spot observation.
Mild.dosage_hindi: पीला रतुआ दिखते ही प्रोपिकोनाज़ोल 25% EC (टिल्ट) 1 मिली प्रति लीटर पानी में छिड़कें।
Mild.irrigation_advice: Avoid irrigating during cold humid mornings; prevent excess soil moisture.

Moderate.chemical_treatment: Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L OR Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L water.
Moderate.dosage_hindi: टेबुकोनाज़ोल 25.9% EC (1 मिली/लीटर पानी)। पूरे खेत में समान छिड़काव करें।
Moderate.irrigation_advice: Wait for wind/sun before irrigating to reduce leaf dampness.

Severe.organic_treatment: Isolate affected field section, alert local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
Severe.chemical_treatment: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1ml/L water. Repeat after 15 days if yellow stripes persist.
Severe.dosage_hindi: अज़ॉक्सीस्ट्रोबिन + डाइफेनोकोनाज़ोल (1 मिली प्रति लीटर पानी)। 15 दिन बाद दोबारा छिड़कें।
Severe.irrigation_advice: Stop canal irrigation until pustule sporulation subsides.

safety_protocols.ppe_advisory_hindi: कीटनाशक छिड़कते समय मास्क, दस्ताने और पूरी आस्तीन के कपड़े पहनें। हवा की विपरीत दिशा में छिड़काव न करें।
safety_protocols.ppe_advisory_english: Wear mask, nitrile gloves, and full-sleeved protective clothing during spraying. Never spray against wind direction.
